title: Инверсия после отрицательных наречий: Never, Rarely, Hardly…when, No sooner…than

why: Инверсия — это обратный порядок слов, как в вопросе. Когда в начало предложения выносится слово с отрицательным или ограничительным значением (never, rarely), фраза звучит эмоциональнее и более книжно. Это письменная, формальная и ораторская речь; в русском похожий эффект даёт «Никогда ещё я не видел...».
formation: Обычно: I have never seen it. С инверсией:
Наречие + вспомогательный глагол + подлежащее + основной глагол
• Never have I seen such a mess. (have I, а не I have)
• Rarely does she miss a deadline. (does + базовая форма: miss)
• Seldom did we meet. (did + базовая форма)
• Hardly had I sat down when the phone rang. (had + V3, потом when)
• No sooner had we arrived than it started to rain. (had + V3, потом than)
Если вспомогательного глагола нет (Present Simple, Past Simple), добавляем do / does / did. С глаголом be он просто выходит вперёд: Rarely is he late.
Отрицание в сам глагол не добавляем: Never did I see (а не Never did I not see).
usage: 1. Never / Never before — «никогда»: Never before had I felt so nervous. (Никогда раньше я не нервничал так сильно.)
2. Rarely / Seldom — «редко»: Seldom do they complain. (Они редко жалуются.)
3. Hardly ... when — «едва..., как»: Hardly had she closed the file when the app crashed. (Едва она закрыла файл, как приложение упало.)
4. No sooner ... than — «не успел..., как»: No sooner had he left than it began to snow. (Не успел он уйти, как пошёл снег.)
В пунктах 3 и 4 событие, о котором говорится сразу после had + V3, произошло первым, а то, что идёт после when / than, — вторым.
signalWords: Never, never before, rarely, seldom, hardly, scarcely, no sooner. Парочки: hardly ... when, no sooner ... than.
mistakes: ✗ Never I have seen it → ✓ Never have I seen it (после наречия идёт вспомогательный глагол)
✗ Rarely he goes there → ✓ Rarely does he go there (нужен does, а глагол без -es)
✗ No sooner had he arrived when... → ✓ No sooner had he arrived than... (no sooner дружит с than)
✗ Hardly had she left than... → ✓ Hardly had she left when... (hardly дружит с when)
✗ Never did I saw → ✓ Never did I see (после did глагол в первой форме)
remember: Отрицательное слово вперёд, потом вспомогательный глагол, потом подлежащее; а в паре hardly — when, no sooner — than.

items.prompt: Never ___ I seen such a beautiful view.
items.answer: have

items.prompt: Rarely ___ he work on weekends.
items.answer: does

items.prompt: Seldom ___ they eat out.
items.answer: do

items.prompt: Hardly ___ she sat down when the phone rang.
items.answer: had

items.prompt: No sooner ___ we arrived than it started to rain.
items.answer: had

items.prompt: Never before ___ I felt so tired.
items.answer: have

items.prompt: Rarely ___ our team miss a deadline.
items.answer: does

items.prompt: Never ___ I imagine it would be this hard.
items.answer: did

items.prompt: (a) Rarely he checks his email. (b) Rarely does he check his email.
items.answer: (b) Rarely does he check his email.

items.prompt: (a) Hardly had I closed the app when it crashed. (b) Hardly had I closed the app than it crashed.
items.answer: (a) Hardly had I closed the app when it crashed.

items.prompt: (a) No sooner had she left than he arrived. (b) No sooner she had left than he arrived.
items.answer: (a) No sooner had she left than he arrived.

items.prompt: (a) Seldom we go to the cinema. (b) Seldom do we go to the cinema.
items.answer: (b) Seldom do we go to the cinema.

items.prompt: (a) Never did I expect this result. (b) Never I expected this result.
items.answer: (a) Never did I expect this result.

items.prompt: (a) No sooner had he finished when the boss called. (b) No sooner had he finished than the boss called.
items.answer: (b) No sooner had he finished than the boss called.

items.prompt: (a) Rarely has the site been so slow. (b) Rarely the site has been so slow.
items.answer: (a) Rarely has the site been so slow.

items.prompt: (a) Hardly did they arrive when it started to snow. (b) Hardly had they arrived when it started to snow.
items.answer: (b) Hardly had they arrived when it started to snow.

exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение, начав с выделенного слова

items.prompt: I have never seen such a big server room. → Never ...
items.answer: Never have I seen such a big server room.

items.prompt: She rarely goes to bed late. → Rarely ...
items.answer: Rarely does she go to bed late.

items.prompt: He had hardly started when the lights went out. → Hardly ...
items.answer: Hardly had he started when the lights went out.

items.prompt: We had no sooner left than it began to rain. → No sooner ...
items.answer: No sooner had we left than it began to rain.

items.prompt: They seldom complain. → Seldom ...
items.answer: Seldom do they complain.

items.prompt: I had never been so nervous before. → Never before ...
items.answer: Never before had I been so nervous.

items.prompt: The manager rarely makes mistakes. → Rarely ...
items.answer: Rarely does the manager make mistakes.

items.prompt: I have rarely felt so relaxed. → Rarely ...
items.answer: Rarely have I felt so relaxed.

exercises.instruction: Вставьте слово или расставьте слова по порядку

items.prompt: No sooner had I sat down ___ the phone rang.
items.answer: than

items.prompt: Hardly had we started ___ it began to rain.
items.answer: when

items.prompt: No sooner had she sent the email ___ she regretted it.
items.answer: than

items.prompt: Hardly had the meeting begun ___ the Wi-Fi stopped working.
items.answer: when

items.prompt: Put in order: rarely / does / late / he / arrive
items.answer: Rarely does he arrive late.

items.prompt: Put in order: had / never / I / so / been / tired / before
items.answer: Never had I been so tired before.

items.prompt: Put in order: seldom / we / do / see / each other
items.answer: Seldom do we see each other.

items.prompt: Put in order: sooner / no / we / had / arrived / than / it / started / to snow
items.answer: No sooner had we arrived than it started to snow.

items.prompt: Никогда я не видел такого красивого города.
items.answer: Never have I seen such a beautiful city.

items.prompt: Он редко опаздывает на работу.
items.answer: Rarely is he late for work. / Rarely does he arrive late for work.

items.prompt: Едва мы приехали в отель, как начался дождь.
items.answer: Hardly had we arrived at the hotel when it started to rain. / No sooner had we arrived at the hotel than it started to rain.

items.prompt: Не успел он нажать кнопку, как программа зависла.
items.answer: No sooner had he pressed the button than the program froze. / Hardly had he pressed the button when the program froze.

items.prompt: Мы редко ужинаем вместе.
items.answer: Rarely do we have dinner together. / Seldom do we have dinner together.

items.prompt: Никогда раньше я не чувствовал себя таким уставшим.
items.answer: Never before had I felt so tired. / Never had I felt so tired before.

items.prompt: Она редко проверяет почту по выходным.
items.answer: Rarely does she check her email on weekends. / Seldom does she check her email on weekends.

items.prompt: Никогда я не думал, что это будет так сложно.
items.answer: Never did I think it would be so difficult. / Never did I think it would be so hard.
